text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — hosted-api queue growth detected in us-east-1 (autoclassifier). Auto-threshold triggered: queued_requests > 5000 for 2m. Paging oncall: @chris.oncall :rotating_light:

chris.oncall: seeing huge fanout from a partner batch job? p95 jumped to 1.3s, p99 to 6.8s. Getting customer 429s.

alice.sre: confirming metrics: host-queue length = 6.1k, inflight tokens spiked, GPU pool utilization 98%, pending VM creations stuck in PROVISIONING (api: provisioner.create -> 502).

bob.platform: autoscaler logs show repeated quota errors from cloud provider when requesting GPUs: 
```
ERROR Provisioner: quotaExceeded, resource: nvidia-a100, code: QuotaLimitExceeded
attempt=23 region=us-east-1
```
backoff loop kicked in, attempts failing, we're not creating new capacity.

dave.runtime: fallback routing should have kicked to smaller model variant, but I see route policy returned 200 with code: NO_FALLBACK_AVAILABLE for many tenant routes. Investigating route-table evaluation.

carla.support: two customers reported increased timeouts and a surge of failed requests in their dashboards. ticket created: CUST-7821. They see partial responses (timeout at 60s).

eve.product: which customers are impacted? priority / paying tiers? Need to coordinate comms.

alice.sre: quick impact summary: ~420 tenants saw error rate > 5% over last 10m. Top affected: partner-x (40% of excess traffic), embedder-svc (20%), unknown bot traffic (15%).

chris.oncall: immediate mitigation plan: 1) throttle incoming non-critical routes at edge; 2) enable canary fallback to cpu-embeddings for non-rtu tenants; 3) manually open temporary GPU quota for autoscaler if provider approves; 4) notify customers and escalate to sales for top-tier. Who can flip 1 and 2?

bob.platform: I can apply an edge rate-limit rule in the CDN to throttle by route tag. Pushing patch now: `patch /infra/edge/rate-limits` -> rolled to region us-east-1.

bob.platform: deployed rate-limit rule: reduced burst for tag=partner-x by 70%. Expect queue reduction in ~90s.

alice.sre: enabling fallback policy to route CPU-quantized model variant for embeddings-only routes (lower throughput, cheaper but keeps requests alive). Will patch rollout in 2 steps: canary to 10% then 100%.

dave.runtime: be careful — CPU variant increases latency for some endpoints, but avoids 60s timeouts. Canary started for tenant subset: logs show immediate drop in queue growth for those keys.

incident-bot: ACTION TAKEN — edge throttle applied, fallback canary enabled. Monitor window: 5m.

chris.oncall: provisioning updates? Any progress with quota request?

bob.platform: cloud support responded: quota increase request opened (SR-44122). They can grant +10 GPUs in 30-60m if we accept regional constraints. Meanwhile provider rate-limits are still returning 429 on create.

alice.sre: current numbers after mitigation (T+4m): queued=3.2k, p95=0.9s, p99=3.9s, error_rate=2.1%. Improvement but still elevated.

carla.support: notifying affected customers with preliminary note: we applied throttles and fallbacks to reduce errors. Asking for tolerances for degraded CPU fallback for non-critical workloads. Template drafted.

eve.product: agree on messaging. For top 5 paying customers, prefer a dedicated note and Slack DM. Carla, can you do that?

carla.support: on it, sending targeted messages now.

chris.oncall: action items tracker: 
- [ ] Confirm provider quota increase (bob)
- [x] Edge throttle applied (bob)
- [x] Fallback canary started (alice/dave)
- [ ] Roll fallback to 100% if stable (alice)
- [ ] Follow-up postmortem owner (chris)

alice.sre: canary looks stable for 10m window, p99 for canary tenants ~4.1s. I'll promote to 100% in 60s if metrics hold.

dave.runtime: note — we saw a codepath where route-policy refused fallback when the request had function-calling metadata. I've pushed a short change to allow embeddings-only fallback while preserving function call semantics. Patch: `service/router: allow-fallback-if-only-embeddings=true` Rolling.

incident-bot: NOTIFICATION — deploy-bot started rollout of router change (deploy-id: rtr-2026-0586). Estimated 2m.

bob.platform: cloud support just approved temporary quota +8 GPUs for us-east-1; they need authorized billing contact to accept. I've pinged finance.

carla.support: partner-x replied — they intentionally kicked a heavy backfill job. They've paused it after our message. Expect traffic drop in 5-10m.

alice.sre: metrics T+14m: queued=900, p95=0.45s, p99=1.8s, error_rate=0.3%. Looks like the combination worked.

chris.oncall: excellent. Next: schedule follow-ups: - open incident ticket, assign postmortem - review autoscaler failure mode for quota errors - add guardrail: when autoscaler fails X times, trigger broader fallback earlier.

eve.product: also ask partner program team to hold a debrief with partner-x. We need to discourage large backfills hitting hosted API tier.

alice.sre: I'll file postmortem and include timeline, metrics, and the suggestion to add an autoscaler circuit breaker for repeated quota failures.

dave.runtime: follow-up item: add route-policy unit test for function-calling + fallback behavior.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — queue growth contained, error rates returned to baseline. Closing pager. Summary: edge throttles + CPU fallback + partner pause + temporary quota request -> stabilized system.

chris.oncall: thanks everyone. I'll own postmortem and next steps. If anything else pops up, re-open this thread. :thumbsup:
